normalized_matching_profile.description: Description 30A ESCAPES presents...Castle in the Sand, a dreamy Gulf-front retreat in the exclusive beachside Monterey community of Seacrest West. Wake up to panoramic ocean views, unwind, and let the sound of the waves refresh your soul. With 3 elegant suites, there’s space for up to 8 guests to relax. Enjoy effortless beach access, a Gulf-front pool, and 4 bikes included to explore 30A’s charm. Whether with family or friends, it’s the perfect backdrop for unforgettable memories. Learn more below…*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Gulf Front condo with panoramic Emerald Coast views - Wake up to breathtaking, uninterrupted views of the sparkling emerald waters—pure coastal bliss.Wrap-around balcony for sunrises and sunsets - Savor your morning coffee or evening glass of wine while soaking in vibrant skies from your own private oasis.Gulf-front seasonally heated pool - A relaxing dip awaits, whether you’re unwinding after a day at the beach or soaking up the sun in style.3 bicycles included for exploring 30A - Feel the breeze as you ride through charming coastal towns, discovering hidden gems along the way.Chic, updated interior with modern furnishings - Experience the perfect blend of style and comfort in a space designed for effortless relaxation.Spacious layout with 3 bedrooms and a bunk nook - Plenty of room to gather with loved ones, while still having space to unwind and recharge.Jacuzzi tub in the Primary Suite - End your day with soothing bubbles and ultimate tranquility in your private spa-like retreat.Steps to dining, shops, and farmers’ markets - Everything you need is just a short stroll away—delicious food, unique boutiques, and fresh local finds.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ “Beautiful condo with perfect views! The wrap-around balcony was ideal for sunsets, and the location couldn’t be better in the heart of 30A.” – Jennifer M.⭐ “The property was as described and incredibly clean. The spacious layout and direct beach access made our family vacation one to remember!” – Steve S.⭐ “Fantastic location with easy access to restaurants and shops. The bikes were a fun bonus. Highly recommend!” – Monica G.*** LIVING AREA ***Step into a light-filled, open-concept living space featuring wall-to-wall windows offering breathtaking Gulf views. Sliding glass doors lead to the private wrap-around balcony, perfect for enjoying a morning coffee or watching the sunset.Comfortable seating with chic, modern furnishings and smart TVStunning Gulf views from floor-to-ceiling windowsPrivate wrap-around balcony for relaxing or entertaining*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Cook with ease in the fully equipped gourmet kitchen featuring stainless steel appliances and a wine cooler. The elegant dining area offers plenty of space to enjoy meals together.Fully equipped kitchen with stainless steel appliancesWine cooler for your favorite beveragesDining table with seating for 6Additional barstool seating for 3 at the kitchen island*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***After a day of adventure, unwind in one of the luxurious bedrooms, each designed for comfort and relaxation.Primary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, gulf-front balcony access and En-Suite with Smart TV and En-suite bathroom with dual vanities, walk-in shower & jacuzzi tubQueen Guest Suite: Queen-size, flat-screen TV and En-Suite with single vanity & shower/tub comboQueen Guest Suite: Queen bed, flat-screen TV and Shared En-Suite with single vanity & shower/tub comboBunk Nook: Twin-over-Twin bunk bed, perfect for kids or extra guests*** MONTEREY COMMUNITY AMENITIES ***Enjoy the ultimate coastal lifestyle with access to premium community amenities, including a Gulf-front heated pool and effortless beach access.Gulf-front seasonally heated poolGrill area for outdoor mealsPrivate gated oceanfront community for added privacyPrivate Beach Access just steps away*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Located in the heart of Seacrest West, "Castle in the Sand" puts you right at the center of a vibrant coastal lifestyle. Enjoy world-class dining, charming boutique shopping, and family-friendly attractions—all within easy reach. Whether you're strolling to nearby beaches or exploring local markets, every moment here feels like an escape to paradise.Local shops and restaurants within minutes: Explore unique boutiques and savor fresh coastal cuisine without going far.Seacrest Beach (6-minute drive) – Relax on pristine white sands and soak up the laid-back, beach-town vibe.Alys Beach (4-minute drive) – Discover elegant architecture, upscale dining, and a tranquil, sophisticated atmosphere.Rosemary Beach (5-minute drive) – Immerse yourself in a lively community filled with cobblestone streets, unique boutiques, and a vibrant small-town charm.The Big Chill entertainment hub – 3-min drive: Enjoy outdoor movie nights, games, food trucks, and a fun, carefree atmosphere for all ages.Farmers’ markets and outdoor events nearby – Walk to enjoy fresh local produce, live music, and the warm energy of weekly community gatherings.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased separately.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.The fireplace is not available for guest use.Waiver required to get access to the 4 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.The community pool is heated from October 1 to December 1.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 222582
